_README: Claims in INSTRUCTION FILES (skills, CLAUDE.md) that the OPERATOR has decided stay
unanchored. The unanchored lane in route.py drops a finding when, for that owner,
BOTH `file` and `claim` appear in the finding line.
Match on a SHORT DISTINCTIVE PREFIX of the claim text, never the whole line: the
line carries an age in days and a line number, and both move. `file` is matched as
a substring too, so a path suffix is enough.
Every entry names WHO decided and WHERE, because this is the operator's ruling and
not a silence the auditor granted itself. `who` is the deciding human or seat;
`where` is the channel and ts a reader can go and check.
EMPTY IS THE CORRECT STARTING STATE. On 2026-10-23 `massive` reported five of their
lines as decided by Ben; the #massive history shows his bare `ok` (ts 1792803712)
answered the HOISTED ASK a0u, which was about editing the files, and said nothing
about the one-offs. An exemption written from that relay would have recorded a
ruling that does not exist, in the one place nobody would ever re-check.
